items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I started with Shearing... George depended – I just out of the clear sky started offering suggestions... I was the first one that stepped out from playing... to go into road managing.

ctx.x: Maybe you can take us to Billie, in terms of what you were doing in that maybe two years or so, because the concert . . .

In that two-year period I was doing all kinds of things with all kinds of different people, working with different groups during that period of time. After working with Billie – come back into New York – but [George] Shearing comes along, but that comes along like 1948, ’49 – the end of ’48 and ’49. Billie, I didn’t stay with her that long. So in between that period I worked with a lot of different groups and a lot of different people.
What was different about Billie, or being a bass man for Billie?
